value.syntax: # [doc = " A complete machine-readable verdict."] # [derive (Debug , Default , Serialize)] pub struct Report { # [doc = " Files that differed, including files refreshed by this operation."] pub findings : Vec < Finding > , # [doc = " Templates with the documents and datasets they render."] # [serde (skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")] pub templates : Vec < Rendering > , # [doc = " Dataset namespaces and their repository-relative paths."] # [serde (skip_serializing_if = "BTreeMap::is_empty")] pub datasets : BTreeMap < String , String > , # [doc = " Templates that cannot map to a text output."] # [serde (skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")] pub unrendered_templates : Vec < String > , # [doc = " Dataset paths not read by any executed template."] # [serde (skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")] pub unread_datasets : Vec < String > , }
